caption: The drawing displays three black-and-white line illustrations of a chair on a beige background. The upper portion shows a top-down view of the chair, which has a curvilinear seat outline with decorative contours and two ribbon-like designs extending from the back and left sides. The lower part of the image includes two side views of the same chair from different angles. Both side profiles reveal scroll-shaped armrests, decorative curves on the legs and the seat’s base, and ornamental elements between the seat and the armrests. The drawing is labeled with a scale of “1/8" to 1'” at the lower left corner. The name “Lorenz Rehnkranz” appears at the bottom right. All lines are rendered in simple black ink, and no shading or additional color is visible in the composition.
title: Corner chair
